original_problem: G private relayer rejected server certificate because CTS gRPC server lacked cts-g in SAN.
first_attempt: A certificate was reissued in cts.crt, the NATS client certificate, rather than server.crt used by the CTS gRPC listener. It did not repair the live TLS endpoint.
correction: Restored the original cts.crt, reissued server.crt with cts-g SAN using the existing server.key and local development CA, and restarted kos-g and relayer-g.
verification: The live CTS-G server on 127.0.0.1:8086 presented cts-g in its SAN; G relayer subsequently consumed local Hub receipts and processed past Hub blocks.
